## Definition of Done
- [ ] Ruff/linters without warning or alerts
- [ ] Unit and integration tests written and passing in CI
- [ ] No secrets (credentials, AWS keys, passwords) in code or images
- [ ] Tested with `docker-compose` or deployed to AWS (indicate which)
- [ ] Updated documentation (README, FastAPI, data model, ADR) if applicable
- [ ] Green CI
- [ ] At least 1 approval from another team member
